title: Centered absolute-moment estimate
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set, let $w_i\ge0$ for each $i\in I$, and let $g:I\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i=0$. Then $\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|g_i|\right)^2\le4\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i^2\right)\left(\sum_{i\in I:g_i>0}w_i\right)$.
replaced: Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$ and let $g:I\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $\sum_iw_ig_i=0$. Then $(\sum_iw_i|g_i|)^2\le4(\sum_iw_ig_i^2)(\sum_{i:g_i>0}w_i)$.
